fixed_size.name: Fixed Size
fixed_size.description: Divides text into equal parts with configurable overlap. Simple and efficient.

recursive.name: Recursive by Character
recursive.description: Divides respecting paragraphs and line breaks. Maintains text context.

by_separator.name: By Separator
by_separator.description: Divides by specific markers (paragraph, line, period). Flexible and adaptable.

by_page.name: By Page
by_page.description: Each PDF page becomes a segment. Ideal for page-organized documents.

by_sentence.name: By Sentence
by_sentence.description: Groups complete sentences until reaching maximum size. Preserves text structure.

semantic.name: Semantic
semantic.description: Automatically identifies where the topic changes. Higher precision, slower.
